plan.title: God View honesty pass: remove simulated ages, rates and effects; fix mislabeled orbs; make the field guide match the code
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-2

narratives.Problem: The God View canvas at /god-view shows simulated, frozen, mislabeled or unattributable information. The per-orb event rate is a constant for the agent count. Idle ages freeze in a cached orb and a canvas time-lapse runs on top of them. The thaw, tide and merge effects write orb state on the canvas or guess a participant. A sequencer agent appears as an issue orb. Failed orbs are labeled "merge failed" although no merge-failure signal exists. Project rings are all cyan. The field guide and the docs describe behavior the code does not have.
narratives.Proposal: Compute every age from a timestamp at read time (orbIdleMinutes plus a 30 s local clock tick) and every per-orb rate from the trailing 60 s of hook events. The canvas derives frost and heat and never writes an orb's state or stage. Effects decorate transitions the data already made: thaw only for stale to active, a tide with a target and no beneficiary, the portal comet only for a merged issue. Orbs exist only for tracker issue ids; the sun and the sequencer animate only while live. Failed orbs name their attention and sit in their stage column; rings differ per project prefix; glyphs cover every model family; every orb in a column has its own slot. Dead UI is removed, and the field guide and both docs pages are rewritten to match. The PRD at .pan/drafts/PAN-5131.md holds the exact code and copy for each of the 19 items.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No persistent on-canvas legend, no layout change and no new panel.
- No new server route, no new domain event and no new server poll (a local clock tick is allowed).
- The canvas must not write an orb's state or stage, and no age or rate may be stored on a cached orb.
- No effect may guess a participant (no tide beneficiary, no fallback tide target).
- Do not raise any row in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt; RiverCanvas.tsx stays at or under 808 lines and useConfluenceData.ts at or under 902.
- No test may read a source file as text, and no skipIf, .skip or .only may be added.
- Do not change satellite orbit speed, the shelf-exit green ring, or the word "stale" in the active-orb tag.
- Do not edit changelog.mdx, docs/god-view.md (lowercase) or design/style-guide/mockups/god-view-confluence.html.
- Do not add a production store hook for the Playwright spec.

autoDecisions.summary: Sliced the work by requirement into 19 items instead of the issue's W1 to W7.
autoDecisions.rationale: RenderOrb extends ConfluenceOrb, so the issue's W1 (remove fields from the data shape) does not typecheck without its W2 (the canvas). Each item leaves the tree typechecking.

autoDecisions.summary: orbIdleMinutes counts from parkedAt for a stale orb with a parseable parkedAt, and from lastActivity in every other case; unknown is 0.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue gives two wordings; this one is computable from the helper's inputs and covers the parked-only case.

autoDecisions.summary: useNowTick lives in confluence/useNowTick.ts and is called inside useConfluenceOrbs and inside useConfluenceMeta.
autoDecisions.rationale: NFR-2 forbids growing useConfluenceData.ts, and calling it inside each hook lets a direct renderHook test see the tick.

autoDecisions.summary: heatFromEventRate is linear from 0.12 at 0 events to 1 at 40; stale orbs target 0.04; heat eases with a 3 s half-life.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue fixes the range and leaves the curve and easing open; linear is the simplest curve and 3 s keeps a spark bump visible.

autoDecisions.summary: flywheelLive reads the cached ['flywheel','status'] query with enabled:false and is exposed as meta.flywheelLive. The issue's implementation checkpoint is closed; there is no roleCounts.flywheel fallback.
autoDecisions.rationale: That query is the source of the sidebar badge (useFlywheelRunning, Sidebar.tsx line 339), the app sidebar is mounted on every page and already polls it, and a disabled observer never fetches, which NFR-1 requires.

autoDecisions.summary: An agent group yields an orb when its id matches the issue's regex or the dashboard store has an issue with that id.
autoDecisions.rationale: Rally ids have no hyphen (US123), so the regex alone would remove real issues from the cast; sequencer-runner matches neither test.

autoDecisions.summary: Lane slots include failed orbs, and advance() eases a failed orb to its slot.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue moves failed orbs into the stage column but gives slots only to active orbs, which would give a failed orb index -1; advance() today never moves a failed orb to tx/ty.

autoDecisions.summary: modelGlyph adds OpenAI o3/o4 ids (G) and QuantumLlama ql- ids (L), and takes the fallback letter from the last path segment.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-7 requires every catalog family; with the issue's table alone o3 reads as Opus, ql-* as Qwen and opencode/<x> as Opus.

autoDecisions.summary: The project ring palette is #00e5a8, #ff8fa3, #b388ff, #6d8bff, #e07aff, #d4b483, #c6ff7a, #ff9e6d; a hyphen-less id uses its letters as the prefix.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for a fixed eight-color palette without values; these eight avoid every color the canvas already uses for a state ring (amber, orange, red, yellow, white, ice).

autoDecisions.summary: Deleted pulseSun, the sun command, playMerge and the merge command.
autoDecisions.rationale: Nothing emits sun after the spawn effect is removed, nothing ever emitted merge, and playMerge would start a comet for a non-merged orb, which FR-5 forbids.

autoDecisions.summary: The VEL tooltip lists only plan, work, review and merge.
autoDecisions.rationale: The velocity route returns only those four stages, so the test and verify counts are dead UI under FR-9.

autoDecisions.summary: The footer test goes in GodViewConfluence.test.tsx, not GodView.test.tsx.
autoDecisions.rationale: GodView.test.tsx has no footer or top-bar assertions; the issue's AC-6 names the wrong file.

autoDecisions.summary: reference/god-view.mdx is added to the docs item; docs/god-view.md (lowercase) is left alone.
autoDecisions.rationale: The Mintlify page repeats the VERIFY stage and the wreck row; the lowercase file describes the older agent-grid God View.

autoDecisions.summary: The issue's AC-8 screenshot is produced by a Playwright spec on the isolated-dashboard fixture.
autoDecisions.rationale: A work agent cannot restart the shared dashboard, and tests/pan-4523-river-bands.spec.ts already runs the built branch on a private OVERDECK_HOME.

autoDecisions.summary: Six God View test files are appended to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt.
autoDecisions.rationale: CI runs only listed frontend tests; the files behind AC-4, AC-6 and AC-7 are not listed today and all pass on this branch.

autoDecisions.summary: The stale label uses the park age for a stale parked orb; the active tag keeps the word stale; the shelf-exit green ring is unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue specifies the first and does not ask to change the other two.
